Household members

Everyone living in a unit who doesn't sign the lease. Tenants add people in their portal and you approve them; tenants report move-outs themselves. Each unit has a people limit (Milwaukee bedroom-size rule; every 2-bedroom starts at 5). Approving past it asks you to confirm. Overnight guests are separate (Parking page, 13-night rule).
